sentences.text: OFFICE No. NOTE 01. 27.02.2026 Dr.YLR,J  I.A.No.01 of 2026  Heard.

Dr.YLR,J  Crl.P.No.1598 of 2026  Heard Sri K.Chidambaram, the learned Senior  Counsel, representing Mr.G.Yaswanth, the learned  counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant  Public Prosecutor.
The learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice on respondent No.2 and file proof to that effect.
The Station House Officer, Akividu Police Station, West Godavari District, is directed to serve notice on respondent No.2 and file proof to that effect.

entities.text: Akividu Police Station, West Godavari District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The victim is aged about 28 years.

She alleges that, when she was studying X Class, the petitioner indulged in the commission of offences under Sections 5(f) and 5(l) read with 6 of 'the POCSO Act'
Contd...
and also offences punishable under Sections 376(3), 376-C, 354-D, 354(c), 385, 506 read with 34 of'
'the IPC'.
There is an enormous delay of nearly fifteen years in lodging the complaint.
Some of the allegations levelled by respondent No.2 relate to 'the POCSO Act'; however, at the time of the alleged incidents, 'the POCSO Act' was not in vogue.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be a stay of all further proceedings in Cr.No.58 of 2026 on the file of the Akividu Police Station, West Godavari District, including the arrest of the petitioner/Accused No.1, until the next date of hearing.
